title: Terrain map support, geometry, vehicle footprints and modality-specific evidence
dataset: GOOSE 3D validation 31 previously selected frames; MAN TruckScenes v1.2-mini 10 recordings; RADIATE tiny_foggy 17 eligible frames; RELLIS-3D pinned author metadata
sensor_configuration: GOOSE VLS-128 raw XYZI and saved PTv3 categories; all corrected TruckScenes LiDAR/radar counts plus panoramic camera visibility metadata; RADIATE radar contrast; no new camera model
annotation_schema: GOOSE 64-class native labels and separate provisional policy; TruckScenes native object boxes and visibility levels; RADIATE footprint annotations; RELLIS author ontology/configuration
split: All 31 preserved GOOSE selections from eight recordings, all 25117 corrected TruckScenes exact-box observations, all eligible fog footprint observations; no RELLIS raw sample

environment.hardware: CPU only; no new inference or GPU work

measurements.name: Unobserved half-metre map-cell observations
measurements.scope: 243660 pooled cells in a 25m disc across 31 scans; unobserved is unknown

measurements.name: Candidate-ground half-metre cells eligible for plane fit
measurements.scope: 70807 cell observations; >=5 points, second covariance eigenvalue >=0.0025m^2

measurements.name: Retained 2.5m square footprint observations
measurements.scope: 61210 candidate centres in 0.5m maps; observed semantic policy only, not validated passability

measurements.name: Low-camera-visibility observations with LiDAR returns
measurements.scope: 8125 level-1 exact-box observations, >=1 return; camera visibility 0-40%, not sensor-specific occlusion

measurements.name: Raw dataset bytes downloaded in this study
measurements.scope: RELLIS primary-source metadata only, 166700 bytes; no new raw or model inference

notes: Successful bounded CPU characterisation. Modality fusion denotes combined analysis sources, not learned fusion accuracy. Twenty main decision-distinct conclusions preserve all prior evidence; temporal D11 is support, D07/D17 and D14/D16 are merged. Local theoretical client report/handover remain outside Git. Physical traversal, true clearance, gravity-aligned grade, object recognition and camera texture improvement are unmeasured.
